description: FREE. Searches open customer job requests by trade and area for service businesses seeking work. Returns anonymous previews without customer contact details. The planned contact unlock price is 5 USDC, without a job guarantee; payment availability is reported separately.

after.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response; leave empty for the first page and keep the same search filters.
after.title: After

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code for the area in which the business seeks work, such as AT.
country.title: Country

limit.description: Maximum number of job previews on this page, from 1 to 100.
limit.title: Limit

region.description: Coarse city or region name, such as wien; not a private customer address.
region.title: Region

trade.description: Stable trade ID returned by service_trade_catalog; only matching anonymous job previews are returned.
trade.title: Trade

name: find_customer_job_requests
title: Passende Kundenanfragen finden
